description.value:
Trigger A creature enters area K3

Effect The haunt creates a sudden burst of terrifying mental static and replays the moment when Researcher Trudine perished, vividly assaulting the creature's senses as though the creature was experiencing the event. The triggering creature must attempt a @Check[will|dc:24] save.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target takes @Damage[(2d8+5)[mental]] damage and becomes @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.Frightened]{Frightened 1}.

Failure The target takes @Damage[(4d8+10)[mental]] damage and becomes @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.Frightened]{Frightened 2}.

Critical Failure The target takes @Damage[(8d8+20)[mental]] damage and becomes @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.Frightened]{Frightened 3}.

details.description: A psychic imprint of Researcher Trudine being torn apart by the Swarm, all while psychic static assails their mind, replays in vivid detail.
details.disable: @Check[occultism|dc:28] (expert) or @Check[religion|dc:28] (expert) to purge the lingering memory

publication.title: Starfinder Secrets of the Swarm Adventure Path
